data.name: Raheemaah
data.gender_notes: Raheemaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is kind, compassionate and merciful. The name Raheemaah carries the meaning “Gracious, Compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, English. Parents who choose Raheemaah usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious, compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are known for their kindness and mercy towards others, even in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Raheemaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gracious, Compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raheemaah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: رحيمة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الرحمة، يعني الرحمة والمودة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رحيمة مشتق من الرحمة، وهي صفة من صفات الله تعالى، وتعني الرحمة والمودة والشفقة. وردت هذه الصفة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وكان بالمؤمنين رحيما' (الأحزاب: 43). يعتبر اسم رحيمة من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يعبر عن صفة من صفات الله تعالى التي يجب على المسلمين التحلي بها.

in_urdu.name: رحیمہ
in_urdu.meaning: رحمت اور مہربانی کا معنی رکھتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رحیمہ نام عربی زبان کی رحمة سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب رحمت، مہربانی اور شفقت ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے، کیونکہ یہ اسلامی تقویم میں رحمت اور مہربانی کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ قرآن مجید میں رحمت کے موضوع پر کئی آیات ہیں، جن میں اللہ تعالیٰ رحیم و رحمان کے طور پر بیان کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रहीमा
in_hindi.meaning: दया और करुणा का अर्थ रखता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: रहीमा नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है दया, करुणा और सहानुभूति। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, क्योंकि यह इस्लामी परंपरा में दया और करुणा के महत्व को दर्शाता है। कुरआन में कई जगहों पर رحمة का उल्लेख है, जिसमें अल्लाह की दया और करुणा की विशेषता है।

in_pashto.name: رحیمه
in_pashto.meaning: د رحمت او مهربانۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: رحیمه نوم د عربي ژبې د رحمة څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د رحمت، مهربانۍ او شفقت معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانانو په کلتور کې ډیر مشهور دی، ځکه چې دا د رحمت او مهربانۍ د ارزښتونو څرګندونه کوي. په قرآن کې د رحمت موضوع پر ډیری آیتونه دي، چې پکې الله تعالی د رحیم او رحمان په توګه بیان شوی دی.

in_english.name: Raheemaah
in_english.meaning: Derived from Rahma, meaning mercy, compassion, and kindness
in_english.long_meaning: Raheemaah is derived from the Arabic root 'Rahma', which means mercy, compassion, and kindness. This name is significant in Islamic tradition as it reflects one of the attributes of Allah, Al-Rahim (The Merciful). The Quran mentions 'Rahma' in various contexts, emphasizing the importance of mercy and compassion in a Muslim's life. Historically, the name Raheemaah has been used across Muslim cultures, symbolizing the desirable trait of being merciful and kind.

data.cultural_impact: The name Raheemaah is a beautiful and revered name in Islamic culture. It is often used as a term of endearment or respect towards those who embody the qualities of kindness, compassion, and mercy. People with this name are often seen as beacons of kindness and benevolence in their communities, spreading warmth and understanding wherever they go. The name Raheemaah reinforces the importance of these virtues in Islamic tradition and encourages individuals to strive for greater levels of compassion towards others.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Raheemaah holds profound spiritual significance. It signifies that one is a servant of God, striving to live a life that embodies the attributes of compassion and mercy. The name is a constant reminder to be kind and understanding towards all beings, as Allah (God) is the most compassionate and merciful of all. The spiritual journey towards becoming a Raheemaah is one of self-improvement, seeking inner peace and practicing kindness in all aspects of life. Being called Raheemaah is not only a beautiful name but also an affirmation of one's commitment to living a life that reflects the divine mercy and compassion of Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gracious, Compassionate" symbolizes One who is kind, compassionate and merciful.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Raheemaah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gracious, compassionate.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Raheemaah bint Abi Bakr was a renowned female companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She was known for her generosity and piety.
